title: Project Ember: Hardcore Mobile RPG, Closed Beta Soon (Android)
description:
Project Ember is a dark fantasy action RPG for Android, played in portrait with one hand. Explore an open world, take on bosses, chase loot, and grow your build through skills, talents, and a permanent Ember tree. Hardcore and grindy on purpose.

Closed beta soon. Full trailer next week.
Comment "beta" to join the closed beta.
